excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

protocol.checkpoint_execution: one cumulative B&B trace per state/lane; roots and nodes are not repaid between checkpoint reads

r2_oracle_audit.checkpoint_inequality: selected score <= exact optimum <= returned upper

protocol.certificate_rule: stratify by exact maximum effective duration; bound every unresolved integer-count box by an exactly checked, outward-rounded repaired LP dual or its inherited analytic upper bound
protocol.candidate_rule: floor the node LP primal within its count box, then greedily fill remaining lanes and visible queue in original option order

work_rule.denominator: 1,000 states times 10^R ordered actions per state

advance_gate.capacity: one checkpoint has eta(load)-alpha>1e-10 at every load
advance_gate.work: the same checkpoint passes every frozen work fraction

decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more frozen execution checks fail
decision_rule.COUNT_SPACE_BNB_SCALING_ADVANCE: R4, R8, and R16 each have a fixed LP checkpoint whose alpha preserves all three lane-capacity eta margins and whose LP-call, LP-matrix, and candidate-evaluation fractions are each below five percent of 10^R
decision_rule.CERTIFIED_WITH_HIGH_MATRIX_WORK_STOP: all scaled lane counts have a capacity-preserving checkpoint but at least one lacks a checkpoint passing every frozen work fraction
decision_rule.COMPUTE_SAVING_WITH_LOOSE_CERTIFICATE_ST: all scaled lane counts have a work-efficient checkpoint but at least one lacks a capacity-preserving checkpoint
decision_rule.NO_COUNT_SPACE_SCALING_TRADEOFF_STOP: neither a common certificate conclusion nor a common work conclusion holds

protocol.claim_boundary: A post-result deterministic development screen on the fixed synthetic 1,000-state scaling grid for identical replicas of the aligned nine-option lane model. The R2 oracle audit covers its 100 ordered actions. This is not an independent confirmation, physical multi-GPU measurement, trajectory result, all-queue theorem, or deployment decision.
protocol.prohibited: R4/R8/R16 ordered-action enumeration, count-vector enumeration, arrivals, trajectories, RNG, server data, paper edits, and post-result changes to the grid, lane counts, LP checkpoints, capacity bridge, or work gate

The R2 oracle audit covers its 100 ordered actions. This is not an independent confirmation, physical multi-GPU measurement, trajectory result, all-queue theorem, or deployment decision.
limitations: The mechanism and LP budgets were designed after observing the earlier scaling failure.
LP calls, matrix cells, and candidate evaluations are distinct logical-work units, not wall-clock equivalents.
The finite grid does not establish a uniform guarantee over all integer queues.
Synthetic lane replication does not measure physical multi-GPU interference.
next_step: Preserve the fixed R4 matrix-work failure without changing its gate or budgets; assess R8/R16 only on a newly frozen independent large-action-regime queue set before any trajectory transition.
